soldier: Head yellow, labrum pale, mandibles yellowish brown with the marginal teeth and the anterior end deep brown, antennae and pronotum pale yellow, abdomen milky white; the dorsum of the head densely covered with short hairs and sparse long hairs, the lateral margins and dorsum of the labrum with a few long hairs interspersed with fine short hairs, the clypeus with long and short hairs alternating, the periphery and dorsum of the pronotum with sparse long hairs interspersed with short hairs, the abdomen densely covered with short hairs. Head rectangular, the anterior and middle parts of the lateral margins nearly parallel, slightly narrower posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly arcuate; labrum wider than long, arc-like, its front transparent and the middle of the anterior margin slightly concave; mandibles short and stout, their tips slightly curved inwards, the outer margin wavy near the base; the marginal tooth of the left mandible situated slightly before the middle, its edge slightly elongate-S-shaped, its tip forming an obtuse angle with the inner margin, the lower half of the molar plate broad with a small sharp tooth in the middle; the postmentum widest at about the anterior quarter, narrowest at the posterior quarter; antennae with 14 segments, the fifth longer than the second; pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior half raised vertically in an arc; the middle of the fore tibia swollen in a bow shape.
